## Flagship Projects
1. **Interactive 3D WebGL Hologram Portfolio:** Cyberpunk interactive portfolio with real-time 3D particle holograms, post-processing bloom, and motion systems.
2. **Bus Fleet Management System:** Comprehensive web platform for real-time transit tracking, route scheduling, and fleet dispatching.
3. **Financial Expense Tracker:** Responsive dashboard for personal and business expenditure tracking, budgeting, and analytics.
4. **Visa Consultation Platform:** Client onboarding and consultation workflow management application.
5. **Event Branding & Graphics Design:** Over 14 branded design assets for IEEE, SLSYWC, Faculty T-Shirts, and University cultural festivals.
